title: 第五百五十七章 你说去哪就去哪第五百五十六章 大楼里高级病房
content_zh:
“少爷，经过这几天从交通大队方面的数据调查，江阳市这一个星期来，共发生二十多起交通事故。”
商务车里，有人正在打电话。
“有几个死亡的？”电话里说道。
“没有，一个都没有，都是小事故，最严重的一个也不过是骨折。”
“这就奇怪了，怎么可能一个都没有，是不是你们调查错了。”
“少爷请放心，我们现在已经到达了殡仪馆，这里应该额外获得一些信息。”
“那好，有情况立刻向我汇报。”
电话那头，陆原挂掉了手里的电话，心里也感觉到有些奇怪。
赵叔叔出了车祸身亡，这么重大的交通事故，交通大队不可能没有任何记录的。
那么就可能只有一个原因，这起重大的车祸，赵思思和对方私了了。
想到这里，陆原皱了皱眉头，赵思思一个女孩子，在这种事情上完全没有任何经验，跟别人私了，肯定会吃亏的吧。
再说殡仪馆这边，商务车此时已经停住，车上下来几个穿着黑色西装的男子，个头平均都在一米八以上，脸上有着不苟言笑的冷峻表情，看着挺让人害怕的。
这几个人哪也不去，径直就向馆长办公室走去，砰的一声，推开了办公室的门。
“你们是什么人？”馆长皱起了眉头。
“我们要查一下你们这里最近收进的死者详细情况。”其中一个黑西装男子说道。
“这里是正规单位，不是随便什么人就可以进来要查东西的，更何况你们私闯我的办公室，马上出去！”馆长脸上露出怒容，这些不知道哪里窜出来的人，馆长正眼都不会看一下，更别提还跟他们周旋了。
“请你配合！”黑西装男子态度依然冷峻，丝毫也没有因为馆长的态度而退缩，他说话的当口，手上已经多了一样东西，顶在了馆长的脑袋上。
是枪。
馆长顿时就吓呆了，枪这玩意顶在脑袋上，在影视里随处可见，但是现实生活里，这已经非常魔幻了。
某些东西是刻在基因里的，比如说恐惧。

“朋友，有话好说。”馆长战战兢兢的，同时很自觉的开始查找最近的资料。
“最近一个星期有没有因为车祸的？”黑西装男子问道。
“刚好有一个。”此时什么血玉堂什么王龙，早已都被馆长抛在了脑后，这个时候，自己的命最重要，他可不敢冒撒谎这个险，弄不好自己的命就没了。
几分钟之后。
馆长看着这几个男子离开办公室，立刻抓起电话，就准备报警。
“不用这么麻烦，我们有介绍信的。”其中一个男子似乎看出馆长意图，扔出一张文件。
馆长只瞥了一眼文件上的公章，立刻就看出来那是省里的公章。
不由倒抽一口冷气，这才明白这几个男子的来头不小。
“原来是省里来的贵客，刚才真的是招待不周，刚才你们直接拿出文件，无论什么事我也一定照办啊，又何必……”馆长此时脸上已经转换出一副笑脸了，尽管心里其实还有一些不解。
“我们喜欢用最直接最快速的方法解决问题而已。”黑西装男子说着话锋又一转，“你现在命令立刻停止火化炉，我们要过去查看。”
“是，是。”
这边殡仪馆的事情不多说，此时江阳医院里。
病房大楼。
“哎呀，恭喜王老弟啊，年轻人恢复就是快，这短短的几天就出院了，不像我们这些老头子，都把病房当成是自己家了，唉。”
黄老亲自和王龙握手，一番客套话是免不了的。
寒暄几句，王龙带着自己的小弟，大摇大摆就离开了病房大楼。
此时医院大门处，挂上了五彩缤纷的横幅。
content_en:
"Master, after investigating the data from the traffic brigade in the past few days, there have been more than 20 traffic accidents in Jiangyang City this week."
In the business car, someone was talking on the phone.
"How many died?" said the phone caller.
"No, not one at all. They were all minor accidents. The most serious one was just a broken bone."
"That's strange. How could there not be one? Did you make a mistake in your investigation?"
"Master, please don't worry, we have arrived at the funeral home now, and we should get some additional information here."
"Well, report to me immediately if there is any situation."
On the other end of the phone, Lu Yuan hung up the phone and felt a little strange in his heart.
Uncle Zhao died in a car accident. It is impossible for the traffic brigade to have no records of such a major traffic accident.
Then there may be only one reason. After this major car accident, Zhao Sisi had an affair with the other party.
Thinking of this, Lu Yuan frowned. Zhao Sisi was a girl who had absolutely no experience in this kind of thing. If she had an affair with someone else, she would definitely suffer.
As for the funeral home, the commercial vehicle had stopped at this time, and several men in black suits got out of the vehicle. The average height was over 1.8 meters, with stern and unsmiling expressions on their faces, which looked quite scary.
These people didn't go anywhere. They walked straight to the curator's office and opened the office door with a bang.
"Who are you?" The curator frowned.
"We want to check the details of the deceased you recently admitted." One of the men in a black suit said.
"This is a regular unit. Not just anyone can come in and check things out. What's more, you broke into my office privately. Get out immediately!" The curator showed an angry look on his face. He wouldn't even look at these people who came out of nowhere, let alone deal with them.
"Please cooperate!" The man in the black suit still had a stern attitude, not flinching at all from the curator's attitude. As he spoke, there was already something in his hand, which was pressed against the curator's head.
It's a gun.
The curator was immediately stunned. Guns are placed on the head. They can be seen everywhere in movies and TV shows, but in real life, this is already very magical.
Certain things are engraved in genes, such as fear.
"Friend, I have something to say." The curator said cautiously, and at the same time he consciously began to search for the latest information.
"Has anyone been involved in a car accident in the past week?" the man in a black suit asked.
"There happens to be one." At this time, the director of Blood Jade Hall and Wang Long had already forgotten everything. At this time, his own life was the most important, and he did not dare to take the risk of lying, otherwise his life would be lost.
After a few minutes.
The curator watched the men leave the office and immediately grabbed the phone, preparing to call the police.
"No need to go to such trouble, we have a letter of introduction." One of the men seemed to see the curator's intention and threw out a document.
The curator only glanced at the official seal on the document and immediately saw that it was the official seal of the province.
I couldn't help but gasp, and then I realized that these men had quite a lot of backgrounds.
"It turns out they are distinguished guests from the province. You really didn't treat them well just now. You just took out the documents. No matter what you do, I will definitely do it. Why bother..." The curator's face had already turned into a smile at this time, although he was still a little confused in his heart.
"We just like to use the most direct and quickest way to solve problems." The man in the black suit said, changing the topic again, "Now you order the cremator to stop immediately. We want to go over and check."
"Yes, yes."
Not much to say about the funeral parlor here, it’s in Jiangyang Hospital at this time.
Ward building.
"Oh, congratulations to Brother Wang. Young people recover very quickly. They were discharged from the hospital in just a few days. Unlike old men like us who treat the ward asNow it’s my own home, alas. "
Mr. Huang personally shook hands with Wang Lung, and a few polite words were inevitable.
After exchanging a few words, Wang Long took his little brother and left the ward building in a swagger.
At this time, colorful banners were hung at the hospital gate.
